args.subject: Action needed: confirm new billing contact address
args.body:
Dear Fabrikam Ltd,

We are working on ticket C-2316 regarding invoices being sent to an old contact address. Please reply with the correct billing contact email/address you would like us to use.

Once we have that, we will update our records and process your $175 late-fee refund.

Best regards
